novelty_claim: Parent does one blind Compose(q, random tactics) shot; ART 2.0 turns composition into a closed compiler loop: goal-adaptive tactic selection plus iterative OPTIMUS-J-guided recomposition (composer-only feedback), still one victim call per goal.
initial_hypothesis: Closing the OPTIMUS feedback loop inside composition converts the consensus refusal class: probe mean ASR >= 0.10 (>=50% relative over locked baseline 0.065) without exceeding 1 victim call per goal.
key_insight: The dominant baseline failure (~80%) is immediate refusal of a one-shot surface reframe; the paper's own OPTIMUS J(S,H) metric, used only for scoring in the parent, can serve as the search feedback that drives recomposition toward low surface harmfulness with preserved intent before the single victim call.
